caption: The drawing depicts a pair of round eyeglasses with thin, metallic frames rendered in shades of grey. The eyeglasses feature circular lenses and have straight, narrow earpieces with small circular loops at their ends. The eyeglasses are positioned horizontally in the center of the drawing with the temples extended outward on either side. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color with no additional objects or decorative elements. In the lower right quadrant of the page, there is a small and unobtrusive handwritten inscription that appears to be a signature and date, executed in a similar grey tone as the eyeglasses. The overall composition is minimal, with the eyeglasses as the sole focus in the blank background.
title: Spectacles
